title: Spells pass a Unit Immune to Spells by in more places
notes: S #150 Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition)'s switch to Attack passes an enemy Unit Immune to Spells by, as its Freeze did (R4599000); a lethal guard Immune to Spells (M #92 Unan's, the Shield Layer's) takes no Spell's hit on itself, which stays on its target (R4599005); a Spell's hit on a chained Unit echoes onto no member Immune to Spells and a split one is divided among the members it may reach (S+ #7 Churnwalker, R4599006); the fuzz monitor's I21 allows the game's own rules inside a Spell's run (R4599001-R4599004, R4599007-R4599009).

player.title: Immune to Spells holds against more Spells
fixes: Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition) no longer switches an enemy Unit Immune to Spells to Attack Position.
Unan and the Shield Layer no longer take a Spell's lethal damage on themselves while they are Immune to Spells: it stays where the Spell dealt it.
A Spell's damage to a Unit Churnwalker chained no longer spreads to a chained Unit Immune to Spells; a split hit is shared among the others.
